Subject: Request: 2 GRC hires + 1 SecEng (band guidance attached)

Stephanie —

As discussed in the leadership sync, Security needs approval to add 3 heads in Q4 FY27: two GRC Analysts (senior IC band) and one Security Engineer II to support platform hardening and audit automation. Attached is a short rationale and the compensation bands we propose. Key points: the GRC roles are mission critical for SOC2 readiness and audit backlog reduction; the SecEng role is to accelerate infra automation for incident response so we can de-risk new model deployments.

Asks:
- Headcount approval for 3 full-time hires (two GRC Sr Analysts, one SecEng II)
- Confirmation of comp bands and offer ranges in comp-band-proposal.xlsx
- Permission to engage external contract support (TPS Consulting) for 8 weeks to cover audits while hires ramp

Notable cost: blended fully-loaded cost ~$420k for first year (see headcount-fin-worksheet.csv). Hiring plan attached. If we can get authorization this week, Talent Partners (Lisa) has shortlisted 5 candidates for GRC and 2 for SecEng and can shorten the timeline to 4–5 weeks.

Thanks — I can be on a quick call to walk through the worksheet.

— Karthik

Hi Steph —

Quick answers: 
- Start windows: GRC Sr Analyst #1 (target 2026-11-01 — latest 2026-12-15), GRC Sr Analyst #2 (target 2026-11-15 — latest 2027-01-15), SecEng II (target 2026-12-01 — latest 2027-02-01). These windows reflect interview scheduling and notice periods.
- SecEng role: hiring bar is Senior IC (strong infra automation + AM/infra security) — not staff. We're prioritizing hands-on engineers with observability and incident automation experience; salary band aligns to L5/L6 depending on experience. We included a small entry-level stretch budget to be competitive in the market.

Also: TPS Consulting can start an audit backlog triage on 10/20 if approved; they quoted a capped SOW of $48k.

If Marcus wants a 10-min runthrough, I can join Monday at 10:00am.

— Karthik

Thanks team — I ran the worksheet with Finance Ops. A few notes: 
- We can reallocate budget for Q4 headcount to cover the three hires if recruiting converts at the lower- to mid-range of the proposed bands. That will be contingent on two things: (1) hiring velocity (candidates in pipeline converted within 6 weeks) and (2) no more than 10% above proposed blended cost for year one.
- I approve the TPS Consulting SOW capped at $48k to bridge audit work, on the condition we get a recruiting plan that commits Talent Partners to weekly candidate updates.

Action items for approval: 
- Steph: please confirm you will own the offer ranges and finalize band-level offers (use comp-band-proposal.xlsx).
- Karthik: coordinate with Lisa (cc’d) to lock interview panel and earliest offer dates.
- Evelyn/Marissa: please confirm org alignment and that GRC hiring runway fits headcount plan.

If we meet the velocity & cost conditions, finance will mark the headcount as approved and release the requisitions.

— Marcus
